name: player_write_mines_zar_section
description: Player::WriteMinesZarSection writes the Mines save section sentinel and serializes active mine runtime instances from alternate weapon banks 4 and 5.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Player weapon-bank/Mines ZAR source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43cc70 validates the unconditional DummyMineData sentinel, 0x60-byte blob writes, banks 4 and 5 only, controller A/B traversal, OptCatalog mine iterator use, runtime position copy, gwObject3DGetScale, gwNodeGetName, MineData%03d blob naming, and abort-on-zero WriteSectionBlob propagation.
